en.headline: Architectural Services Department says former manager left on personal grounds
en.dek: The department rejected reports that a chief project manager overseeing Queen Mary Hospital’s new clinical building lifts was asked to resign, saying she applied three months in advance and left in mid-August.

zh.headline: 建築署：前總工程策劃經理以個人理由請辭 與瑪麗升降機報道不符
zh.dek: 建築署指有關瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機工程的前總工程策劃經理被要求辭職的報道與事實不符，該人員已按機制提前三個月申請並於8月中離職。

en.headline: Woman rescued after paraglider catches in tree at Ma On Shan
en.dek: A 38-year-old foreign woman was freed uninjured after her paraglider became snagged in a tree about 10 metres high near Ngong Ping on Saturday afternoon; the Government Flying Service assisted.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山昂平滑翔傘女子被困樹上 消防救出無恙
zh.dek: 一名38歲外籍女子周六下午在馬鞍山昂平玩滑翔傘時被困約10米高大樹，消防及飛行服務隊到場救出，事主無受傷。

en.headline: 39 fall ill after school lunch in Sha Tin; supplier ordered to suspend
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a suspected food-poisoning cluster at Baptist (Sha Tin Wai) Lui Ming Choi Primary School after pupils and staff ate soy-braised chicken drumsticks and penne on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 沙田小學39師生疑食物中毒 午膳供應商須暫停運作
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查浸信會沙田圍呂明才小學懷疑食物中毒群組，37名學生及兩名職員進食供應商提供的滷水雞髀及長通粉後腹痛腹瀉。

en.headline: Hong Kong Shue Yan University opens new college of communication and creative industries
en.dek: The private university marked its 55th anniversary on Saturday by announcing the establishment of its fourth faculty and the enrolment of nearly 2,500 new students this academic year.

zh.headline: 樹仁大學成立傳理資訊及創意產業學院 迎約2500新生
zh.dek: 樹仁大學周六慶祝創校55周年，宣布獲批成立第四所學院，新學年錄取近2500名新生，非本地生佔近三成。

en.headline: Couple arrested after money dispute turns physical in Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: A 65-year-old man and his 55-year-old wife were arrested on Saturday morning after an argument over money in their On Tai Estate flat; the woman was treated for a headache.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪夫婦因金錢爭執動粗 先後被捕
zh.dek: 周六早上，安泰邨一對夫婦因金錢問題爭執，丈夫襲擊妻子，妻子則持菜刀，兩人分別涉普通襲擊及藏有攻擊性武器被捕。

en.headline: Man injured after being hit by tram in Causeway Bay
en.dek: A man in his 30s suffered abrasions to his arms and legs after a tram struck him near a pedestrian crossing on Yee Wo Street on Saturday afternoon; he remained conscious.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣電車撞傷過路男子 手腳擦傷清醒送院
zh.dek: 周六下午近4時，一輛電車在怡和街撞倒一名約30多歲男子，傷者手腳擦傷，清醒被送往律敦治醫院。

en.headline: Sheung Shui Swimming Pool temporarily closed after vomit found
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department closed the North District pool for cleaning and superchlorination; it is scheduled to reopen at 8.55pm.

zh.headline: 上水游泳池發現嘔吐物暫時關閉 今晚約9時重開
zh.dek: 康文署因池內發現少量嘔吐物進行清潔及超氯化處理，北區上水游泳池暫閉，預計晚上8時55分重開。

en.headline: Sightseeing boat sinks off Hung Hom new waterfront; no one trapped
en.dek: Firefighters and divers searched the vessel after a report of it taking on water around 2pm; the boat had been moored for more than a month.

zh.headline: 紅磡新海濱觀光船入水下沉 消防證實無人被困
zh.dek: 下午近2時有途人報稱船隻入水，消防派出蛙人搜索後確認無人受傷或受困，船隻已停泊逾一個月。

en.headline: Housing Authority reviews concrete quality at Tung Chung Area 42 public housing
en.dek: Some structural components in Blocks 3, 4 and 5 require further testing after routine cube strength checks; the site is confirmed structurally safe.

zh.headline: 東涌42區公屋混凝土質量需進一步測試 房委會確認結構安全
zh.dek: 第3、4及5座部分結構構件在恒常方塊強度測試中發現問題，房屋署已確認地盤整體結構安全，並要求承建商抽芯複檢。

en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus for fifth anniversary
en.dek: The exhibition in the Focus Gallery presents models, drawings and material samples from the firm that designed the museum building, running from 12 September.

zh.headline: M+五周年展「Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦」今起開放
zh.dek: 展覽於二樓焦點空間展出設計M+大樓的瑞士事務所捐贈模型、繪圖及物料樣本，由9月12日起舉行。

en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning as temperatures climb
en.dek: The warning was raised at 3.35pm on Saturday; the public is advised to take precautions against heat stroke while sunny periods continue before later showers.

zh.headline: 天文台下午發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台周六下午3時35分發出酷熱天氣警告，提醒市民慎防中暑，日間仍有陽光，稍後轉多雲有驟雨雷暴。

en.headline: State funeral for former chief executive Tung Chee-hwa set for 20 September
en.dek: A source confirmed the date on Saturday; state leaders and central government officials are expected to join the funeral committee.

zh.headline: 前特首董建華國葬定於9月20日舉行
zh.dek: 消息周六確認國葬日期，國家領導人和中央政府官員預期加入治喪委員會。

en.headline: Police College becomes first government department allowed to award bachelor degrees
en.dek: Commissioner Chow Yat-ming said the free Security and Criminal Investigation (Honours) Bachelor of Policing programme is expected to launch by year-end for serving junior officers.

zh.headline: 警察學院成首個可頒授學士學位政府部門 年底推免費課程
zh.dek: 警務處長周一鳴在結業會操後公布，學院上月獲評審局通知可頒授學士學位，免費「安保及刑事調查（榮譽）警務學士」課程預計年底推出。

en.headline: Body of 53-year-old woman found in waters off Lamma Power Station
en.dek: Firefighters recovered the woman after a report of a floating figure around 10am on Saturday; police classified the case as found body.

zh.headline: 南丫島發電廠對開海面發現女屍 53歲內地女子不治
zh.dek: 警方周六上午約10時接報有人形物體漂浮海面，消防到場救起女子後證實死亡，案件列發現屍體。

en.headline: Man restrained after harassing elderly diner and assaulting staff at Tin Shui Wai…
en.dek: Police classified the Friday evening incident as discovery of a person with suspected mental disorder; no one was seriously hurt.

zh.headline: 天水圍麥當勞男子滋擾老婦襲職員 市民合力制服
zh.dek: 39歲鄧姓男子周五晚被制服後送院檢查，案件列發現懷疑精神紊亂人士。

en.headline: Influenza remains high; eight in ten cases are H1, director says
en.dek: Laboratory positive rate reached 13 per cent last week and hospital admission rates stay above baseline, according to the Director of Health.

zh.headline: 流感仍處高位 八成屬甲型H1 林文健籲盡快接種
zh.dek: 上周化驗室陽性比率達13%，入院率高於基線，兒童嚴重個案累計19宗。

en.headline: 82-year-old woman dies after drowning at Clear Water Bay Second Beach
en.dek: Lifeguards rescued the swimmer about 5 metres offshore on Saturday morning; she was pronounced dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.

zh.headline: 清水灣二灘八旬女泳客遇溺不治
zh.dek: 周六早上救生員在離岸約5米處救起昏迷泳客，送將軍澳醫院後證實死亡。

en.headline: Peking opera series continues at Cultural Centre this weekend
en.dek: A youth staging of Sizhou Tanmu plays on Saturday, with a gala including Battle of Ma Chao scheduled on Sunday at the Grand Theatre.

zh.headline: 京劇系列本周末續在文化中心上演
zh.dek: 「香江國粹情」周五揭幕，周六演青春版《四郎探母》，周日演唱會以武戲《戰馬超》開場。

en.headline: Police arrest 51 in New Territories South anti-crime sweep
en.dek: Operation Ragingstorm over Friday and Saturday targeted bars, game centres and vehicles across Sha Tin, Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, Lantau and the airport district.

zh.headline: 新界南「熾風」反罪惡行動拘51人
zh.dek: 警方於9月11至12日在沙田、葺青、荃灣、大嶼山及機場一帶設路障並巡查酒吧機舖，涉嫌罪行包括危駕及賭博。

en.headline: Police College passing-out parade graduates 127 officers
en.dek: Seventeen probationary inspectors and 110 constables completed training on Saturday, with Deputy Commissioner Kan Kai-yan taking the salute.

zh.headline: 警察學院結業會操 127名督察學警畢業
zh.dek: 周六有17名見習督察及110名警員結業，由警務處副處長（國家安全）簡啟恩擔任檢閱官。

en.headline: Man arrested over FEHD Mark Six dispute released on bail
en.dek: Police said the 36-year-old detained on suspicion of theft after a prize-sharing row among colleagues must report back in mid-October.

zh.headline: 食環職員六合彩糾紛案男子獲准保釋
zh.dek: 警方表示，周五因涉嫌盜竊被捕的36歲男子已獲准保釋候查，須於10月中旬向警方報到。

en.headline: The Gruffalo plays its last Hong Kong dates this weekend
en.dek: The 60-minute English-language stage show, based on the picture book, continues at the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts through Sunday.

zh.headline: 音樂劇《古飛樂》本周末演藝學院煞科
zh.dek: 改編自繪本的一小時英語演出，周六及周日在灣仔香港演藝學院廖湯慧靈戲劇院尚有場次。

en.headline: Watches and cash taken in Repulse Bay Road burglary
en.dek: A 25-year-old woman reported a bedroom window forced open on Friday night; police said three watches worth about HK$437,000 and about RMB20,000 were missing.

zh.headline: 淺水灣道單位遭爆竊 失約44萬元手錶及人民幣
zh.dek: 25歲女子周五深夜報案，指睡房窗戶被撬、屋內有搜掠痕迹；警方初步點算失3隻手錶及約2萬元人民幣，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Beauty and fitness trades back seven-day cooling-off, Yau says
en.dek: The commerce chief told RTHK the government hopes to put an amendment to the Trade Descriptions Ordinance before the Legislative Council in the first half of next year.

zh.headline: 丘應樺：美容健身業界支持7日冷靜期
zh.dek: 商經局局長在港台《星期六問責》表示，完成研究後希望明年上半年把修訂《商品說明條例》的方案提交立法會。

en.headline: Sold-out Leslie Cheung 70th-birthday concert plays West Kowloon tonight
en.dek: The outdoor show at the AXA Bamboo Theatre starts at 7.15pm, with a 1,956-drone display timed for 9.12pm.

zh.headline: 張國榮70誕辰音樂會今晚西九舉行 門票售置
zh.dek: 《繼續寵愛·張國榮70誕辰·音樂會》今晚7時15分於安盛竹翠公園開場，主辦方安排1,956部無人機於9時12分升空。

en.headline: Belt and Road Summit closes with record 60-plus MOUs
en.dek: The two-day government-organised event drew more than 6,200 participants from over 70 countries and regions and deals valued above US$3.1 billion.

zh.headline: 一帶一路高峰論壇閉幕 簽署逾60份合作備忘錄創新高
zh.dek: 為期兩日的論壇吸引來自70多個國家及地區逾6,200名政商代表，連同會前及會期成交，涉及金額逾31億美元。

en.headline: Hong Kong actor Simon Lui, known as King of Ghosts, dies at 62
en.dek: Fellow actor Frankie Ng said Lui’s wife confirmed he died of gastric cancer in a Guangzhou hospital on 7 September.

zh.headline: 「鬼王」雷宇揚胃癌病逝廣州 享年62歲
zh.dek: 演員吳志雄周五轉述，雷宇揚妻子馬莉證實他於9月7日在廣州醫院逝世，家屬希望低調處理。

en.headline: Planning Department delays Sai Kung dog shelter shutdown by three months
en.dek: Enforcement against an unauthorised animal boarding use at Ho Chung is suspended until 12 December after the operator lodged a planning application.

zh.headline: 規劃署暫緩西貢狗舍執法 中止期限延至12月12日
zh.dek: 西貢蠅涌大藍湖路狗舍被指在自然保育區作動物寄養屬違例發展，署方因應規劃申請將強制執行通知書期限延長三個月。

en.headline: Tseung Kwan O Park Central hosts Dopamine Dessert Festival this weekend
en.dek: More than 20 popular local dessert shops gather at the mall on 12 and 13 September offering cheesecakes, mochi, cinnamon rolls and other sweets ahead of Mid-Autumn.

zh.headline: 將軍澳中心本周末辦多巴胺甜品節 逾20店齊集
zh.dek: 9月12至13日於將軍澳中心舉行，雲集手工巴斯克芝士蛋糕、豆腐麻糬、肉桂捲等人氣甜品，為中秋預熱。

en.headline: Elderly couple found dead in Ma On Shan flat; police treat case as non-suspicious
en.dek: Firefighters forced entry to a unit at Heng On Estate after neighbours reported a foul smell; the pair, both in their 70s, are believed to have had underlying health conditions.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山恆安邨揭雙屍案 七旬夫婦倒斃單位 警指無可疑
zh.dek: 鄰居發現單位傳出異味報警，消防破門發現一對約70多歲夫婦遺體，初步相信無刑事成分，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: HKDI opens Leslie Cheung memorial exhibition with rarely seen photographs
en.dek: The free show at Hong Kong Design Institute runs until 15 November and features previously unpublished images from the 1980s and 1990s by local and Korean photographers.

zh.headline: 知專辦張國榮紀念展 首度公開八九十年代珍藏照片
zh.dek: 「風華70・設計共鳴 哥哥紀念展」即日至11月15日於將軍澳香港知專設計學院免費開放，展出本地及韓國攝影師珍藏影像。

en.headline: Customs seizes 7.5 kg cannabis buds at airport; Mainland woman arrested
en.dek: Officers found the suspected drugs, valued at about HK$1.5 million, inside the check-in baggage of a 31-year-old passenger who arrived from Bangkok via Taiwan on Friday.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢7.5公斤大麻花拘內地女子 市值約150萬元
zh.dek: 一名31歲內地女旅客周五從曼谷經台灣抵港，寄艙行李藏懷疑大麻花被檢獲，她隨即被捕。

en.headline: Police arrest 36-year-old over disputed Mark Six jackpot among FEHD staff
en.dek: A health inspector is detained on suspicion of theft after colleagues alleged he refused to share a half first-division prize of more than HK$30 million from last Saturday’s draw.

zh.headline: 食環署職員夾份中六合彩逾三千萬 警拘36歲男子涉盜竊
zh.dek: 據報15名街市活化組人員合資中半注頭獎，負責買票的衞生督察疑拒平分後被拘捕，現正扣留調查。

en.headline: Hong Kong names 11-strong equestrian squad for Asian Games
en.dek: The team will compete in dressage, eventing and jumping at the Tokyo venue, mixing experienced riders with three debutants.

zh.headline: 港隊公布亞運馬術11人名單 涵蓋三項賽事
zh.dek: 香港中國馬術總會公布亞運馬術代表隊，將於東京場地出戰盛裝舞步、三日賽及場地障礙賽。

en.headline: Silver Bond allotment hits records; up to 13 lots per investor
en.dek: The government received 476,703 applications totalling HK$119.3 billion for the 11th batch, and raised the final issuance to HK$55 billion.

zh.headline: 第11批銀債配發結果出爐 最多可獲13手
zh.dek: 政府公布認購申請476,703份、總額1,193億元均創紀錄，最終發行額加至550億元。

en.headline: Two workers injured as 800kg iron tubes roll down slope in Ma Tso Lung
en.dek: A female and a male worker were struck by a bundle of iron tubes during site investigation works near Lok Ma Chau on Friday afternoon and airlifted to hospital.

zh.headline: 落馬洲馬草壟斜坡鐵通滾落 兩工人受傷直升機送院
zh.dek: 周五下午近馬草壟勘探工地，一紥約800公斤鐵通滾落斜坡擊傷兩名工人，傷者清醒由直升機送往東區醫院。

en.headline: Hong Kong Park lights up with giant moon for Mid-Autumn
en.dek: A large illuminated moon installation with hanging planets and star lights is now on display in the Central park each evening, free to visit.

zh.headline: 香港公園中秋巨型月亮裝置亮燈
zh.dek: 中環香港公園現設太空主題中秋裝置，巨型月亮配吊掛行星及星光，每晚約6時起亮燈，免費入場。

en.headline: Police investigate alleged Mark Six prize dispute among FEHD staff
en.dek: A 36-year-old health inspector is wanted after colleagues reported that a shared winning ticket from last Saturday’s jackpot was not divided as agreed.

zh.headline: 食環署職員夾份中六合彩 衛生督察疑拒平分被通緝
zh.dek: 據報15名活化街市組人員合資中半注頭獎逾三千萬元，負責買票的36歲衛生督察疑拒平分後失蹤，警方列盜竊通緝。

en.headline: Private car mounts pavement in Ho Man Tin; three pedestrians hurt
en.dek: A probationary-licence private car left Chung Hau Street near Carmel Secondary School on Friday afternoon, striking three pedestrians who were taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

zh.headline: 何文田私家車剷上行人路 三途人受傷送院
zh.dek: 周五下午近6時，一輛掛P牌私家車在忠孝街近迦密中學失控上行人路，撞傷一男兩女，全部清醒送伊利沙伯醫院。

en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival opens next Thursday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department display runs from 17 to 27 September, with lighting from 6.30pm to 11pm and an extended midnight close on Mid-Autumn night.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會下周四起開放
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會於9月17至27日舉行，每晚6時半至11時亮燈，中秋夜延長至午夜，免費入場。

en.headline: Three more imported dengue cases recorded; yearly total reaches 31
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said two of the latest patients had travelled to the Philippines and one to the Chinese Mainland and Vietnam during the incubation period.

zh.headline: 新增3宗外地傳入登革熱 今年累計31宗
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布，9月4日至10日錄得3宗輸入個案，兩名病人潛伏期內到過菲律賓，另一人到過內地及越南。

en.headline: School bus hits cyclist in Ping Shan; woman in 40s hospitalised
en.dek: A female cyclist was knocked unconscious after being struck by a school bus turning into Ping Kwai Road on Friday afternoon and was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital.

zh.headline: 屏山屏葵路校巴撞單車 女騎手一度昏迷送院
zh.dek: 周五下午約4時50分，一輛校巴由青山公路轉入屏葵路時撞倒一名騎單車過路的40多歲女子，傷者一度昏迷，送屯門醫院治理。

en.headline: First cohort of dental interns completes year; 46 join Department of Health
en.dek: Of 74 local graduates who finished the mandatory 12-month programme, about 62 percent will take up posts in the public dental service, the Department of Health said.

zh.headline: 首屆牙科實習計劃74人完成 46人加入衞生署
zh.dek: 約六成二畢業生選擇加入公營牙科服務，新一屆78名應屆生已於本月展開實習。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 148 points, extending five-day slide
en.dek: The benchmark finished at 24,805 on Friday on turnover of HK$228.43 billion, taking the weekly loss to about 3.3 percent amid rate concerns and thinner volumes.

zh.headline: 恒指收報24805點跌148點 連跌五日全周累跌約3.3%
zh.dek: 周五成交228.43億元，科技指數及國企指數同步偏軟，內地滬指跌逾1%。

en.headline: Scaffolding worker dies after falling with dog-arm boom in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A man in his 50s fell from rooftop scaffolding at Yu Chau Street on Friday morning and was certified dead at Caritas Medical Centre; the Labour Department is investigating.

zh.headline: 深水埗搭棚工連狗臂架墮下身亡 勞工處調查
zh.dek: 一名約50歲男工今早在汝州街唐樓天台棚架工作時連同狗臂架墮下，送明愛醫院後不治，勞工處正調查事故原因。

en.headline: Meta AI rolls out in Hong Kong with Cantonese support
en.dek: The chatbot is available via its dedicated app and website from Friday, with integration into Facebook, Instagram, Threads and WhatsApp to follow.

zh.headline: Meta AI正式登陸香港 支援廣東話及本地文化
zh.dek: 今日起可透過專屬應用及網站使用，稍後將陸續加入Facebook、Instagram、Threads及WhatsApp。

en.headline: Standard Chartered Hong Kong Marathon 2027 public ballot opens
en.dek: Public registration for the January 17 race began at 2pm on Friday, with total main-event places raised to a record 78,000.

zh.headline: 渣打香港馬拉松2027公眾抽籤報名今午開始
zh.dek: 主賽事總名額增至歷來最高的78,000個，公眾報名今日下午2時起至9月20日晚上7時截止。

en.headline: Water main bursts near Tai Tong Road Light Rail stop in Yuen Long
en.dek: Muddy water flooded part of Castle Peak Road and a pavement on Friday morning, prompting temporary lane closures while the Water Supplies Department carried out emergency repairs.

zh.headline: 元朗青山公路近大棠路輕鐵站水管爆裂 部分行車線封閉
zh.dek: 今早約7時許大量黃泥水湧出行人路及馬路，水務署關掣搶修，運輸署封閉往錦田方向部分行車線。

en.headline: Driver arrested after light goods vehicle hits 92-year-old woman in Chai Wan
en.dek: Police charged a 35-year-old man with dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after the vehicle struck a pedestrian near Fung Wah Estate on Friday morning.

zh.headline: 柴灣客貨車撞倒92歲老婦 司機涉危駕致他人身體嚴重受傷被捕
zh.dek: 警方指今早11時許峰霞道近翡翠道交界發生意外，35歲本地男司機涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體嚴重受傷被捕。

en.headline: Yuen Kee Food clears HKEX hearing, eyes October listing
en.dek: The dumpling-chain operator is preparing to raise between HK$300 million and HK$400 million, according to people familiar with the matter, after completing three funding rounds.

zh.headline: 袁記雲餃通過港交所聆訊 擬10月上市集資3至4億
zh.dek: 知情人士指，餃子連鎖品牌母公司已通過上市聆訊，擬於10月展開招股，集資額視乎估值及需求而定。

en.headline: Driver charged after lorry nearly hits three schoolgirls in Tsuen Wan
en.dek: Police arrested a 43-year-old man within hours of a dashcam video showing a medium goods vehicle apparently running a red light at a pedestrian crossing on Kwok Shui Road.

zh.headline: 荃灣貨車衝燈險撞三女學生 43歲司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方留意到網上短片後迅速調查，昨晚拘捕一名43歲本地男司機，控以一項危險駕駛罪，9月25日在沙田裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Weekend brings stronger winds, showers and thunderstorms
en.dek: The Observatory expects a broader low-pressure area over the South China Sea to combine with the northeast monsoon, producing windier conditions and more showers from Saturday afternoon into Sunday.

zh.headline: 周末風勢較大 部分地區有驟雨及雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台預料南海中部低壓區與東北季候風共同影響，周六下午起至周日廣東沿岸風勢較大，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴，並有湧浪。

en.headline: Lee Tung Street lantern walk adds weekend Mid-Autumn markets
en.dek: More than 800 lanterns are already up on the 200-metre Wan Chai stretch; themed stalls run on Saturday and Sunday this weekend and the next.

zh.headline: 利東街中秋燈籠展加開周末市集
zh.dek: 灣仔利東街200米林蔭道掛出逾800盎燈籠至10月19日，本周末及下周末設中秋主題攤檔，中秋夜有LED火龍表演。

en.headline: Kennedy Town New Praya seawall proposed as Grade 2 historic structure
en.dek: The Antiquities Advisory Board endorsed the grading for the 19th-century granite wall as the government plans a new waterfront boardwalk.

zh.headline: 堅彌地城新海旁海堤擬列二級歷史建築
zh.dek: 古諮會通過擬議評級，海濱事務委員會主席何文堯稱新板道會離開海堤，方便從不同距離觀看。

en.headline: Hang Seng extends losing streak into a fifth session
en.dek: The benchmark was down about 319 points, or 1.3 percent, in late morning trade, with technology and property shares leading the retreat.

zh.headline: 恒指連跌第五日 午前跌約319點
zh.dek: 恒生指數周五上午10時34分報24,635點，跌318點或1.28%，科技股及地產分類指數較弱。

en.headline: Plain cigarette packs gazetted, in force from March 2027
en.dek: Standard brown packaging, new graphic warnings and digital duty stamps will apply after a nine-month transition, the Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office said.

zh.headline: 統一煙包設計今日刊憲 明年3月起分階段實施
zh.dek: 傳統煙包須改暗吮色及指定字體，取消焦油尼古丁標示，並更新圖像忠告及加貼完稅防偽標籤，12月全面實施。

en.headline: Alliance leaders jailed for up to seven years three months
en.dek: A designated national security court sitting at West Kowloon sentenced Chow Hang-tung, Lee Cheuk-yan and Albert Ho on Friday and fined the dissolved group HK$1.5 million.

zh.headline: 支聯會案鄒幸彤判囚7年3個月 李卓人7年
zh.dek: 西九龍法院周五就煼動顛覆國家政權罪判刑，何俊仁囚5年2個月，已解散的支聯會罰款150萬元，須三個月內繳清。

en.headline: CAVALLUNA plays its last Hong Kong dates this weekend at Kai Tak
en.dek: The European equestrian theatre production, making its Asian debut, has remaining performances through Sunday at Kai Tak Arena, with tickets from HK$395.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術劇場CAVALLUNA本周末在啟德上演最後場次
zh.dek: 亞洲首站餘下場次今晚至周日在啟德體藝館舉行，普通票由395元起，由香港賽馬會呈獻。

en.headline: Black Kite stages three-day craft beer festival at PMQ from tonight
en.dek: FLOCKFEST runs in the Central courtyard through Sunday with eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, local food stalls and indie sets; admission is free.

zh.headline: 黑鴛今晚起在元創方辦三日精釀啤酒節
zh.dek: FLOCKFEST今晚至周日在中環PMQ地面廣場舉行，八間港日酒廠、本地小食及獨立音樂演出，免費入場。

en.headline: Midland forecasts 15 percent rise in Hong Kong home prices this year
en.dek: The agency said first-hand deals rebounded in August and expects primary transactions to jump 50 percent in the final quarter as buyers return.

zh.headline: 美聯料今年樓價升15% 仍低於2021年高位一成六
zh.dek: 代理周四簡報指8月一手成交回升至1,100宗，預期第四季一手成交按季升五成，二手升一成。

en.headline: SFC suspends Cloudbreak Pharma shares over suspected IPO rigging
en.dek: The regulator directed the exchange to halt trading from 9am on Thursday, saying it has serious concerns the 2025 listing may have created an artificial impression of demand.

zh.headline: 證監會勒令撥康視雲停牌 指IPO或涉人為操縱需求
zh.dek: 證監會周四上午9時起指示聯交所暫停02592股份買賣，指對去年上市或被操縱以營造需求假象表示嚴重關注。

en.headline: Seven vehicles collide on Tuen Mun Road near Hong King Garden
en.dek: Police were called at 7.21am to the Kowloon-bound carriageway; three drivers were sent to hospital and the Transport Department closed some lanes.

zh.headline: 屯門公路近豪景花園7車相撞 3司機送院
zh.dek: 警方早上7時21分接報往九龍方向近豪景花園發生連環相撞，運輸署封閉部分行車線，上址交通繁忙。

en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron show for museum’s fifth anniversary
en.dek: Models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss firm that designed the West Kowloon building go on view in the Focus Gallery from Saturday until 10 January.

zh.headline: M+五周年展出Herzog & de Meuron中國項目捐贈
zh.dek: 由設計西九大樓的瑞士事務所捐出的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，周六起於二樓焦點空間展出至明年1月10日。

en.headline: Government opens 179 graduate-grade civil service posts on Saturday
en.dek: Applications for Administrative Officer, Executive Officer II and four other degree grades run online until 11.59pm on 2 October, with a joint exam on 5 December.

zh.headline: 六個學位職系周六起聯招 合共179個空缺
zh.dek: 政務主任、二級行政主任等職位周六起接受網上申請，截止10月2日晚上11時59分，聯合招聘考試定於12月5日舉行。

en.headline: Eight patients and two staff test positive for influenza A at Wong Tai Sin Hospital
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said the cluster spans a chest ward and an infirmary ward; the patients are in isolation and stable, and the two staff members are on leave.

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院兩病房爆甲流群組 8病人2職員確診
zh.dek: 醫管局指胸肺科及療養病房共十人對甲型流感呈陽性，病人隔離治療情況穩定，兩名職員正休假。

en.headline: Hong Kong Economic Journal founder Lam Hang-chi dies at 86
en.dek: The newspaper said Lam Shan-muk, who wrote under the pen name Lam Hang-chi, died on 6 September; Richard Li called him a respected figure in the city’s press.

zh.headline: 《信報》創辦人林行止逝世 享年86歲
zh.dek: 報社周四公布，原名林山木的林行止於9月6日在家人陪同下離世；電訊盈科主席李澤楷發聲明致哀。

en.headline: Taxi driver trapped after hitting works vehicle near Kowloon Station
en.dek: An empty taxi struck the rear of a parked cherry-picker on Austin Road West shortly after midnight; the 60-year-old driver was freed with minor injuries and sent to hospital.

zh.headline: 九龍站圓方對開的士撞工程車 60歲司機一度被困
zh.dek: 空載的士周五凌晨在雅翔道天橋撞向停泊工程車車尾，的士車頭嚴重損毀，司機清醒送廣華醫院，工程車司機及工人無羞。

en.headline: Police arrest 38-year-old man after finding drugs in reported stolen car in To Kwa Wan
en.dek: Officers discovered a previously reported missing private car on Chekiang Street on Thursday evening; a man who approached the vehicle was detained after officers found suspected cocaine inside.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣浙江街發現報失私家車 警檢懷疑可卡因拘38歲男
zh.dek: 警員周四傍晚在浙江街發現一輛早前報失的私家車，其後一名男子走近車輛，被截查後未能出示身份證，車內檢獲約0.91克懷疑可卡因。

en.headline: Composer Olivier Cong presents coral soundscape at L’ÉCOLE tonight
en.dek: The free Magic Hour event at the School of Jewelry Arts in K11 MUSEA runs from 6pm to 9pm as part of the ongoing Precious Coral exhibition, with registration required.

zh.headline: 江逸天今晚於L’ÉCOLE以珊瑚標本演繹聲景
zh.dek: K11 MUSEA珠寶藝術學院「日落雅聚」系列活動今晚6時至9時舉行，免費但須預先登記，配合《深珊瑚》展覽。

en.headline: ICAC charges former HKEX vice-president over asset declaration failure
en.dek: Geoffrey Tong Po-hang, 39, faces one count of failing to comply with a Prevention of Bribery Ordinance notice; he is due to plead at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Friday.

zh.headline: 廉政公署起訴港交所前副總裁 涉未按要求申報資產
zh.dek: 39歲湯寶衡被控一項不遵從《防止賄賂條例》通知書要求罪，周五於東區裁判法院答辯。

en.headline: Two foreign tourists arrested at airport after Chai Wan MTR depot graffiti
en.dek: Police detained the pair, aged 30 and 34, in the departure hall about six hours after they allegedly cut security wiring, sprayed large murals on a stabled train and fled over a three-metre wall.

zh.headline: 兩外籍男遊客闖柴灣港鐵車廠塗鴉 機場離境大堂被捕
zh.dek: 警方指兩人涉嫌剪爛圍牆防盜線潛入車廠，在停泊列車噴上約一米乘五米塗鴉後翻牆逃走，約六小時後在機場登機前落網。

en.headline: ReThink HK sustainability conference opens at Convention Centre
en.dek: The two-day event at Hall 1 of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre brings together business, government and NGO leaders on climate action and sustainable solutions through Friday.

zh.headline: ReThink HK可持續發展博覽會於會展開幕
zh.dek: 為期兩日的亞洲氣候行動與可持續商業活動在灣仔會展1號館舉行，匯聚商界、政府及非政府機構代表至周五。

en.headline: MTR says police have identified tour guide in Tsim Sha Tsui fare-evasion case
en.dek: The rail operator is working with police and the Travel Industry Authority after footage showed more than 30 people exiting without tapping cards behind a guide on 23 August.

zh.headline: 港鐵：警方已鎖定尖沙咀逃票事件導遊身份
zh.dek: 8月23日晚上有旅行團懷疑不正當出閘，估計逾30人未付正確車資，港鐵正與警方及旅監局蒐證跟進。

en.headline: Sun Hung Kai Properties underlying profit rises 4.6 percent to HK$22.85 billion
en.dek: Hong Kong’s largest developer reported stronger residential sales and a final dividend of HK$2.93, lifting the full-year payout as the local property market continued its recovery.

zh.headline: 新鴻基地產基礎溢利升4.6%至228.5億元
zh.dek: 本港最大發展商全年合約銷售約381億元，末期息2.93元，全年派息3.91元，物業市場持續復甦。

en.headline: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted of deterring reporter from union role
en.dek: Eastern Magistrates’ Courts found Dow Jones guilty of preventing Selina Cheng from standing for Hong Kong Journalists Association chairmanship but cleared it of unlawful dismissal over the union activity.

zh.headline: 華爾街日報出版商阻記者競逐記協主席 被裁定有罪
zh.dek: 東區裁判法院裁定道瓊斯出版公司故意阻止前記者鄭嘉如行使工會權利，但裁定解僱指控不成立。

en.headline: Three arrested after Mong Kok car chase linked to alleged drug deal
en.dek: Police detained a 29-year-old disqualified driver, his girlfriend and a passenger after a private car fled officers, struck vehicles and left an officer injured on Monday; the trio face drug and traffic charges.

zh.headline: 旺角私家車逃避截查連撞多車 警拘兩男一女涉販毒
zh.dek: 警方拘捕29歲停牌司機、其19歲女友及46歲男乘客，指周一旺角懷疑進行毒品交易時逃避截查，撞傷一名警員並損毀多車。

en.headline: Water supply cut overnight for seven Wong Tai Sin estates after pipe damage
en.dek: A 750 mm fresh-water main was accidentally damaged by a contractor at a Po Kong Village Road works site; the Water Supplies Department aims to restore supply by 7am Friday after emergency repairs from 11pm.

zh.headline: 黃大仙蒲崗村道食水管受損 七屋苑今晚11時後停水搶修
zh.dek: 直徑750毫米食水總管於行人路坑道工程地盤被電力承判商意外損壞，水務署安排今晚11時後停水緊急維修，爭取明早7時前恢復供水。

en.headline: CHP records two more severe paediatric flu cases; school outbreaks rise
en.dek: An 11-year-old boy and a six-year-old boy remain in serious condition with influenza A complications; the centre said school outbreaks have climbed to 73 cases involving 398 people since the new term began.

zh.headline: 衞防中心錄兩宗兒童流感嚴重個案 學校爆發升至73宗
zh.dek: 11歲及6歲男童分別因甲型流感併發敗血性休克及腦炎、嚴重肺炎留醫深切治療部，情況嚴重；中心指開學後學校流感樣疾病爆發已達73宗，涉及398人。

en.headline: John Lee meets Shenzhen Party chief Jin Lei; sides sign cooperation pacts
en.dek: The Chief Executive and the Shenzhen Municipal Committee secretary discussed deeper collaboration and witnessed the signing of memoranda covering finance, innovation and technology, and supporting mainland firms going…

zh.headline: 李家超晤深圳市委書記靳磊 見證簽署多份合作備忘錄
zh.dek: 行政長官與深圳市委書記在禮賓府會面，就深化港深合作交換意見，並共同見證涵蓋金融、創科及服務企業出海等範疇的合作備忘錄和協議簽署。

en.headline: Hong Kong coordinating state funeral for late first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa
en.dek: Authorities are preparing arrangements to honour Tung as a deputy national-level leader for his contributions to the one country, two systems framework, the government said it would announce details in due course.

zh.headline: 當局正協調董建華國葬安排 稍後公布詳情
zh.dek: 消息指特區政府正為已故首任行政長官董建華籌備國葬，以肯定其作為副國級領導人及對一國兩制的貢獻；政府表示稍後公布安排。

en.headline: Two men jailed for up to 38 months over secession conspiracy
en.dek: District Court sentenced a courier and a waiter who admitted conspiracy to commit secession after joining a Taiwan-based group advocating Hong Kong independence; the judge said their actions risked social stability.

zh.headline: 兩男認串謀分裂國家罪 分別判囚38個月及36個月
zh.dek: 區域法院周四判處兩名承認參與「香港民主建國聯盟」的男子監禁，法官指行為不利社會安定及國家統一；同案另一被告早前已判囚42個月。

en.headline: HKU centre reports rise in under-15 suicides despite overall decline
en.dek: On World Suicide Prevention Day the centre estimated 976 suicides in 2025, a rate of 13 per 100,000, while the under-15 rate climbed to a decade high; it also issued updated media guidelines covering social platforms.

zh.headline: 港大中心：整體自殺率微降 15歲以下個案顯著上升
zh.dek: 世界防止自殺日港大賽馬會防止自殺研究中心公布2025年數據，估計976宗自殺死亡，整體率降至每10萬人13宗，但15歲以下比率升至近十年高位；中心同步更新涵蓋社交媒體的報道建議。

en.headline: Government to gazette plain packaging rules for traditional tobacco products
en.dek: Subsidiary legislation will be published on Friday and take effect on 1 March 2027, with a nine-month transition period ending on 1 December 2027; duty-paid cigarette labels will also be introduced.

zh.headline: 傳統吸煙產品統一包裝規定明日刊憲 明年3月生效
zh.dek: 附屬法例周五刊憲，明年3月1日生效，設9個月過渡期至12月1日全面實施；同步引入完稅煙標籤，違規最高罰款5萬元。

en.headline: SFC orders suspension of Cloudbreak Pharma shares
en.dek: Trading in the clinical-stage ophthalmology biotech was halted from 9am under Securities and Futures Ordinance rules; the stock had fallen about 88 per cent since its July 2025 listing.

zh.headline: 證監會指令撥康視雲停牌
zh.dek: 臨床階段眼科生物科技公司撥康視雲（02592）今早9時起按證監會指令停止買賣，股價自去年7月上市以來已累挫約88%。

en.headline: Man dies after collapsing on Tsuen Wan Line train at Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: A man in his 60s was found unresponsive on a morning train; service on the line was briefly delayed and platforms became crowded before normal operations resumed.

zh.headline: 港鐵長沙灣站列車男乘客昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 一名六旬男子今早在荃灣綫車廂內暈倒，送院後不治；荃灣綫服務一度受阻，多個車站月台擠迫，荃灣站曾關閉。

en.headline: Mid-Autumn lantern carnival returns to Victoria Park on 17 September
en.dek: LCSD’s Bing-wu lantern carnival runs free of charge from 17 to 27 September, alongside the Tourism Board’s first international lantern showcase at the same park.

zh.headline: 丙午年中秋綵燈會下週四維園亮燈
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會9月17日至27日於維園免費開放，旅發局同期首辦國際中秋綵燈匯，文化中心露天廣場另設光影裝置至10月11日。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Uzbekistan sign gold market cooperation pact
en.dek: Christopher Hui exchanged an MOU with Uzbekistan’s central bank at the Belt and Road Summit; the two sides were due to meet again on Thursday.

zh.headline: 港與烏茲別克簽備忘錄加強黃金市場合作
zh.dek: 許正宇周三在一帶一路高峰論壇與烏茲別克央行副主席交換諒解備忘錄，財庫局周四續開雙邊會議。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 25,000 in morning trade
en.dek: The benchmark opened at 24,985, down 289 points or 1.15 per cent, the first break of that level in nearly six weeks, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 恒指早市失守二萬五千關 近一個半月首見
zh.dek: 恒生指數競價時段報24,985點，跌289點或1.15%，港台報道這是近一個半月首次跌穿25,000點。

en.headline: CAVALLUNA equestrian theatre continues at Kai Tak through Sunday
en.dek: The European horse-and-theatre production, making its first Asian stop, has remaining performances at Kai Tak Arena from Thursday evening to 13 September.

zh.headline: CAVALLUNA馬術劇場啟德續演至週日
zh.dek: 歐洲馬術劇場《穿梭異境》亞洲首站在啟德體藝館上演，本周四晚至9月13日仍有場次，由香港賽馬會呈獻。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Shenzhen customs meet on new Huanggang port operations
en.dek: Acting Commissioner Woo Wai-kwan inspected joint one-stop vehicle lanes after talks with Huanggang Customs on passenger and cargo checks and emergency coordination.

zh.headline: 港深海關開會部署新皇崗口岸運作
zh.dek: 署理關長胡偉軍周三與皇崗海關關長施宏圖開會，並視察聯合一站式車道測試，雙方未公布開通日期。

en.headline: Two drivers arrested after parking row turns violent in Yau Tong
en.dek: A mixer-truck driver and a minibus driver were detained after a dispute near Sam Ka Tsuen Ferry Pier on Wednesday evening; one man was treated for a head injury.

zh.headline: 油塘泊車爭執兩司機被捕 一人頭部受傷
zh.dek: 周三傍晚三家村碼頭對開因泊車起衝突，田螺車司機涉嫌以鐵通打傷小巴司機，兩人分別涉襲擊罪被捕。

en.headline: One-year-old girl dies after being found unresponsive in Kai Tak flat
en.dek: Police were called to a Light Public Housing unit on Olympic Avenue before dawn; the child was sent to Kwong Wah Hospital and later certified dead.

zh.headline: 啟德簡約公屋一歲女嬰昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 警方清晨接報世運道簡約公屋六座單位有女嬰昏迷，救護員送往廣華醫院搶救後證實不治，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: Peking opera series opens Friday at the Cultural Centre
en.dek: The China Peking Opera Art Foundation brings three nights to the Grand Theatre from 11 to 13 September, with a Jockey Club sponsorship.

zh.headline: 香江國粹情周五起文化中心連演三晚
zh.dek: 中國京劇藝術基金會香港行9月11日至13日在文化中心大劇院上演，由香港賽馬會獨家贊助，張建國領衔。

en.headline: Observatory cancels overnight thunderstorm warning before dawn
en.dek: The alert was lifted at 4.45am after isolated storms over the New Territories; Thursday is forecast to be dry with sunny periods and a high near 32C.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨取消通宵雷暴警告
zh.dek: 警告於上午4時45分取消，新界北部清晨錄得超過20毫米雨量；周四日間大致乾燥，最高氣溫約32度。

en.headline: ZA Bank to take new Causeway Bay headquarters at Lee Garden Eight
en.dek: The virtual bank will occupy about 45,000 square feet across four floors of Tower 3, with a move planned in 2027, Hysan and the lender said.

zh.headline: 眾安銀行承租利園八期四層作新總部
zh.dek: 虛擬銀行ZA Bank將租用銅鑼灣利園八期3座約4.5萬平方呎寫字樓，料2027年啟用，遷離數碼港。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$102 million of illicit tobacco in Kwai Chung and Kwu Tung
en.dek: Officers raided an export staging point and two packaging stores on Tuesday and arrested a local lorry driver, Customs said on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 海關葵涌古洞搗三私煙點檢逾億元貨
zh.dek: 海關周二在葵涌物流倉及古洞兩個鐵皮場檢獲約1,280萬支未完稅香煙及6,300公斤煙草，市值約1.02億元，拘捕一名本地貨車司機。

en.headline: Labour Department files 25 charges over Wang Fuk Court worker deaths
en.dek: Prosecutions under the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance target duty holders over the November fire that killed five contractor staff at the Tai Po estate.

zh.headline: 勞工處就宏福苑五名工友遇難提25項檢控
zh.dek: 勞工處經徵詢律政司後，根據《工廠及工業經營條例》向承建商、工程顧問及個別人士提出公訴，涉去年11月大埔宏福苑維修地盤火警。

en.headline: Stanley Whitney’s first Asia solo opens at Gagosian Hong Kong
en.dek: The American abstract painter’s exhibition Isn’t Love the Strangest Thing, featuring new and recent grid paintings, runs from 10 September to 7 November at the Pedder Building gallery.

zh.headline: Stanley Whitney亞洲首個個展於高古軒香港開幕
zh.dek: 美國抽象畫家Stanley Whitney的《愛難道不是奇妙無比》展出新作及近作，9月10日至11月7日於中環畢打行高古軒舉行。

en.headline: FLOCKFEST craft beer and music festival opens at PMQ this weekend
en.dek: Black Kite Brewery hosts eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, indie live sets and local food at the Central courtyard from Friday to Sunday, with free admission.

zh.headline: FLOCKFEST精釀啤酒音樂節本周末PMQ舉行
zh.dek: 黑鳶啤酒於中環元創方廣場舉辦為期三天的精釀啤酒與獨立音樂節，匯聚港日八間酒廠，免費入場。

en.headline: Hong Kong’s first astronaut leads live Tiangong Class for students
en.dek: Lai Ka-ying and her Shenzhou-23 crewmates delivered a 90-minute science lesson from the space station to pupils at her alma mater and campuses across Hong Kong and Macao.

zh.headline: 港產航天員黎家盈主持天宮課堂
zh.dek: 黎家盈聯同神舟二十三號乘組周三上午從空間站為港澳學生進行90分鐘直播授課，主場設於其母校荃灣公立何傳耀紀念中學。

en.headline: Medical Council rejects target time frames for handling complaints
en.dek: The watchdog told Legco a statutory requirement for milestones is unnecessary and can be handled administratively, as it responded to a government reform bill.

zh.headline: 醫委會反對投訴處理設法定時限
zh.dek: 醫委會書面回應立法會指無需在法例訂明各步驟目標時限，可按現行行政方式處理，並就政府改革草案提出意見。

en.headline: Two mainland visitors arrested as unlicensed tour guides in Sai Kung and Central
en.dek: A man and a woman, both 31, were detained in a joint Immigration Department and Travel Industry Authority operation targeting illegal guiding services ahead of Golden Week.

zh.headline: 旅監局聯同入境處拘兩名內地無牌導遊
zh.dek: 一男一女均31歲，分別在西貢東壩及中環被捕，涉嫌違反逗留條件提供導遊服務，國慶黃金周前加強執法。
